spec_match.rationale: Runs the explainer's exact MSE workflow — MediaSource, objectURL attach, sourceopen, addSourceBuffer with the IAMF type, fetch+appendBuffer of the official Chromium test stream — with no invented API.

interactive.rationale: Run button executes all four real steps with per-step live results; reset restores the initial state; the audio element is a real playback target.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises step-by-step real outcomes with genuine NotSupportedError on non-supporting builds; matches observed behavior exactly.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles sourceopen timeout, the unsupported addSourceBuffer branch, and cross-origin fetch failure after a successful buffer creation as distinct honest outcomes.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5113656292540416; page links workbench, matrix, and the official web demo.

conformance.rationale: The suite's sourcebuffer-honest-error assertion runs this page's step 3 contract verbatim (succeed, or throw exactly NotSupportedError consistent with isTypeSupported).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: steps 1–2 green (created, sourceopen), step 3 the real NotSupportedError with Chrome's own message quoted in the status, step 4 correctly unreached; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read including the 6-pass/1-fail conformance panel.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts distinguish the supported path (iamf-mse-sourcebuffer, iamf-mse-appended) from the honest unsupported branch (iamf-mse-unsupported-branch, checking the error name).

design_system.rationale: Step results use emerald/rose on paper (AA); CSS variables only; buttons inherit the global style.

accessibility.rationale: Steps are labelled rows with textual results; status is role=status aria-live; the audio element has an aria-label; controls are native buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Step rows flex with wrapping; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Complete step 4 on an IAMF-enabled build
openQuestions.detail: On a build with IamfAudioDecoding the workflow should reach the fetch+append step; the Chromium test stream is cross-origin, so if crsrc.org blocks CORS the page reports the decoder-present-but-fetch-failed branch. Consider hosting a small IAMF sample on-origin (v152 asset) so playback can complete end-to-end.

guidanceConsulted.query: step progress list live results screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Represent multi-step progress as labelled text results, announced via live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each step row pairs the literal call with a textual result; overall status is aria-live.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive step rows flex wrap small screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let step rows wrap instead of fixing widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Step rows are flex with the result pushed via margin-left:auto; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the workflow executes for real on Chromium 141 — MediaSource construction and sourceopen succeed, addSourceBuffer throws the genuine NotSupportedError which the page quotes verbatim, and the fetch step is honestly unreached. Console clean at both viewports. End-to-end playback needs an IAMF-enabled build and ideally an on-origin sample; recorded as the open question.
